tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Every slide's background. Never a lighter grey, never a photo, never a gradient. The feed is bright; we are the dark tile.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: The US-check panel on story slides, sitting on ground. Nothing else.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines (hook-*), lede and body on ground and ground-raised. 17.6:1 on ground, 16.1:1 on ground-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Kickers, labels, datelines, outlet countries, the handle. On ground and ground-raised (8.2:1 / 7.5:1). Never for a headline or a number that carries the claim.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one loud color. The on-air square in the kicker, the stat line, filled outlet squares, meter segments, the swipe cue, and the whole ground of a Flash hook. 10.7:1 on ground, 9.9:1 on ground-raised. Use it once per slide for the thing that matters most; if two things are amber, neither is.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: All text and marks on a signal ground (the Flash variant of HookCover). 10.7:1.

tokens.name: static
tokens.usage: Marks that carry meaning but must not compete with signal: unfilled outlet squares, the meter track, outlet chip borders, hatch stripes. 3.7:1 on ground and 3.4:1 on ground-raised, meets the 3:1 floor for meaningful marks. Never for text.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative rules and panel borders only. Too faint to carry meaning on purpose.

families.display: "Big Shoulders Display", "Big Shoulders", Impact, "Arial Narrow", sans-serif

styles.name: hook-xl
styles.usage: Reels and Stories only (1080x1920). Max 3 lines, max 14 characters a line.

styles.name: hook-l
styles.sample: TRUMP'S ENVOYS PITCHED RUSSIAN GAS TO KYIV.
styles.usage: The HookCover headline. Max 3 lines of about 16 characters. If it needs 4 lines, cut words, do not drop to hook-m.

styles.name: hook-m
styles.usage: Flash variant headline (dark on signal), BundleCover headline, Closer headline. Max 4 lines.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The one number-claim per slide, always in signal (on-signal on Flash). Max 2 lines.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Story numbers on the BundleCover, in signal. Decorative scale; the title beside it carries the meaning.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Witkoff and Kushner pitched Kyiv on resuming Russian gas transit.
styles.usage: The full claim on a Receipt slide and story titles on the BundleCover. Max 4 lines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: NYT broke it Oct 17. Checked Oct 19-21: no follow-up at the other 10.
styles.usage: The US-check sentence and method lines. 38px on the 1080 canvas is about 14px on a phone, the floor for body text. Never smaller.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Any outlet we couldn't check is named here.
styles.usage: Caveats and footnotes only. Never the claim itself.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Top-left of every slide, uppercase. The brand (SCHMIM KNEWS) in ink, then the segment (Dead Air, How we check) and the date in ink-muted. Always preceded by the on-air square in signal.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels above outlet chips, the grid and the meter. Uppercase, ink-muted.

styles.name: meta
styles.sample: Reported Oct 17, 2026 · The New York Times
styles.usage: Datelines, status text, the URL. ink-muted.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Outlet chips. Name in ink, country in ink-muted.

styles.name: handle
styles.usage: Bottom-left of every slide in ink. The only place the handle appears on a slide.

spacing.note: An 8px scale on a 1080px canvas. Slides are set at full size and scaled down by the renderer, never designed small.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between meter segments.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside the kicker, between outlet grid squares and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and the thing it labels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked blocks inside a slide.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between the hook and the stat.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: The slide gutter on all four sides. Nothing touches the edge except the Flash ground and the hatch band.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap above the footer when content is short. Never fill it with more text.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: The bottom keep-out zone on a 4:5 post. Instagram overlays the carousel dots there; put only the footer row above it.

radius.note: A square system. Instagram rounds the tile for us.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every panel, chip, square and band. No exceptions.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Reserved. Not currently used on any slide; kept so nobody invents a third radius.

canvas.note: Export sizes and keep-out zones, in canvas pixels.

tokens.name: post-w
tokens.usage: Carousel slide width (4:5).

tokens.name: post-h
tokens.usage: Carousel slide height (4:5). Export PNG at 1x; Instagram re-encodes anyway.

tokens.name: reel-w
tokens.usage: Reels and Stories width (9:16).

tokens.name: reel-h
tokens.usage: Reels and Stories height (9:16).

tokens.name: reel-safe-top
tokens.usage: Reels: nothing that matters above this line; the UI covers it.

tokens.name: reel-safe-bottom
tokens.usage: Reels: nothing that matters below this line; caption, handle and buttons cover it.

tokens.name: post-safe-bottom
tokens.usage: Carousel: only the footer row inside the bottom 144px (same as space-18).
